description.p: SecureEye logs you in with your face, through PAM, wherever a password is asked for: sudo, the lock screen, the login manager. This app manages it:

ul.li: enroll face models with a live camera preview, and remove them
test recognition and see how close each frame comes to the certainty threshold
switch face login on and off, and edit the configuration
check and control the SecureEye service and the camera

description.p: The camera and the face models are handled by the SecureEye service; the app never opens the camera itself.
First release of the SecureEye app: face models, enrollment with a live preview, a recognition test, configuration and service control.
